newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News to pay rugby league damages.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News to pay rugby league damages.

text.p: News Corp subsidiary News Ltd will have to pay damages for disruption caused to the Australian Rugby League (ARL) season in 1995 by its attempt to create a rebel Super League, the Federal Court ruled on Friday.
The court ruled in favour of an appeal by Rupert Murdoch's media organisation against an earlier court decision barring the rebel league until the end of the century.

But the the three-judge panel ruled that the original judgment against News and the Super League companies, which found they breached their obligations to the ARL within the 1995 season, had been justified.
"The trial judge was also justified in finding that News and the Super League companies had induced the rebel clubs to breach these implied terms," the judges said in their ruling.
"...The remedies available to the league and ARL should be confined to an award of damages," they said.
"The matter should be referred back to the trial judge for damages to be assessed."
The ruling applies only to the 1995 season, not the just completed 1996 season which was disrupted by the legal battle between the ARL and Super League over the future of rugby league.
